data_layers: Published supplier/product reference with immutable source revision
Editable project assumptions and override history
Actual component configuration and evidence review

geometry: braces in both vertical planes and plan
head/base total length, exposed extension and engagement
U-head load bearing point and bearer eccentricity
members: Fy / Fu / E / G with certificate and standard edition
imperfections and residual stress/buckling model selected under design basis
loads: construction live loads and placement effects
pouring sequence / unbalanced bay / concentrated loads
horizontal actions / out-of-plumb imperfections under selected code
supports: top restraint stiffness and supporting structure
sole plates / supporting slab / soil settlement
support slab age / punching / reshoring stages

requirements: same certified product and part revision
same loading distribution and design basis
analysis_routes.out_of_scope: Do not interpolate / extrapolate without documented manufacturer method. Switch to a separately verified calculation route or return INCOMPLETE.

requirements: appropriate material and member buckling resistance model
analysis_routes.scope: A first-order pin-jointed truss or Euler-only column check cannot close all checks.

checks.method: Transfer nodal reactions and eccentric moments. Tributary area is valid only where the actual load path supports it.
Check P-Delta and P-delta, sway/torsional modes and plan stability. A failed/singular or unconverged solve is not a valid low-utilization result.

required_inputs: N, My, Mz, Vy, Vz, T
checks.method: Check compression buckling, biaxial bending/interactions, shear/torsion, local section effects and splice locations under the selected standard.
Check member resistance and deformation separately from joint resistance.
Evaluate tension and compression with the applicable separate values. Include clearance and geometry. Record whether assembly capacity already covers the member.
Check individual limits and all combined-action / standard-ledger / rosette occupancy interactions. Evaluate source sign convention explicitly.
Check concurrent actions around the complete node. A single connection rating does not establish whole-rosette resistance.
Check axial tension/contact compression and resultant bending with pairing and installation limits. No tension transfer from an unpinned friction-only assumption.
Check exposed screw stability, thread and nut strength, contact plate, welds, eccentric loading and product assembly limits.
Check bearing, slab bending/punching, settlement, sliding, uplift and overturning including anchors/ties where used.
Check vertical settlement, differential settlement, sway and bearer/joist deformation with traceable project limits.
Track checks during erection, pouring, stripping and reshoring. Report unsupported stages individually.

resistance_basis_rules.ALLOWABLE: Only service actions matching the documented allowable convention.
resistance_basis_rules.DESIGN_Rd: Only design actions from compatible ULS combinations.
resistance_basis_rules.CHARACTERISTIC_Rk: Requires the chosen standard and explicit conversion/factors before comparison.
resistance_basis_rules.ULTIMATE_TEST: Test result only; no automatic conversion to working capacity.
resistance_basis_rules.STIFFNESS: Model property, never a load resistance.
resistance_basis_rules.factor_ownership: Record each load/resistance factor once. Do not apply an extra generic safety factor or divide a published Rd again by default.

aggregation_rules: Any known exceeded check remains FAIL even if another required check is incomplete.
Any missing required check/input or stale result prevents PASS.
PASS for screening requires every required entity/stage/combination covered and comparable bases, plus valid convergence/equilibrium.
confirmed=true is never assigned by data import, calculation, dropdown selection or manual capacity entry.
A changed source or geometry invalidates dependent results; no carry-forward of prior PASS.
acceptance_benchmarks: Analytic axial member / simply supported beam and cantilever responses
Spring envelope inverse and tangent / zero gap / sign reversal boundaries
Eccentric U-head and brace nodal moment equilibrium
Pinned/partial/fixed support sensitivity and genuine instability
Asymmetric pours / corner loads and global force-moment balance
Manufacturers independently checked exact configurations within stated scope
Units and factor ownership, null vs zero, incompatible basis rejection
Required-check coverage, stale-revision invalidation and no automatic confirmation
integration_note: This file specifies proposed coverage and data requirements. It does not claim the shared app implements a complete nonlinear frame, joint interaction or system capacity solver.
